assembly_summary: The original twelve-stroke drawing follows the observed head lowering, low hold and return. Eyes, face/mouth, ears and head are bound separately to observed source anchors; native body/chest remains below, and the unobserved tail stays beyond the close-up crop. The plain wall is drawn once.
review_note: Independent source-pose, native identity and normal-speed motion review pending.
